name: Sunway Berhad
overview: 2026年，Sunway Berhad 提出以现金加新股方式有条件自愿全面收购 IJM Corporation Berhad，最终取得33.43%股权，未达到50%门槛；同时一家 dormant 子公司 MCL Land (Pantai View) Sdn Bhd 完成成员自愿清盘。此外，公司推进 ESOS 新证券发行及常规企业事务。
overview_en: In 2026, Sunway Berhad launched a conditional voluntary take-over offer for IJM Corporation Berhad, satisfied by cash and new Sunway shares, and ultimately held 33.43% of IJM shares, below the 50% threshold; meanwhile, a dormant subsidiary, MCL Land (Pantai View) Sdn Bhd, completed its member's voluntary winding up. The company also progressed ESOS new securities issuances and routine corporate matters.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年主要事项为对 IJM Corporation Berhad 的有条件自愿全面收购，以及一家 dormant 子公司的自愿清盘。
segments.note_en: Key activities this year were the conditional voluntary take-over offer for IJM Corporation Berhad and the voluntary winding up of a dormant subsidiary.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: dormant 子公司 MCL Land (Pantai View) Sdn Bhd 完成成员自愿清盘，并于2026年11月19日向马来西亚公司委员会提交清盘人最终会议申报表。
actions.text_en: Dormant subsidiary MCL Land (Pantai View) Sdn Bhd completed its member's voluntary winding up, with the liquidator lodging the Returns by Liquidator Relating to Final Meeting with the Companies Commission of Malaysia on 19 November 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 收购要约于2026年4月6日截止，171,716,556 股，占 IJM 总投票权股份的33.43%，未收到使持股超过50%的有效接纳。
actions.text_en: The offer closed on 6 April 2026 with Sunway holding 1,171,716,556 IJM shares, representing 33.43% of IJM's total voting shares; no valid acceptances were received that would bring holdings above 50%.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 股东在 EGM 上批准以每股 RM3.15 有条件自愿全面收购 IJM Corporation Berhad 全部普通股（不含库存股），其中10%以现金 RM0.3150 支付，90%以每股 RM5.65 发行新股支付。
actions.text_en: Shareholders approved at an EGM the conditional voluntary take-over offer to acquire all ordinary shares of IJM Corporation Berhad (excluding treasury shares) at RM3.15 per offer share, satisfied by 10% cash of RM0.3150 and 90% via new Sunway shares at an issu…

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: Sunway 通过有条件自愿全面收购 IJM Corporation Berhad 并取得33.43%股权，将 IJM 纳入为联营/投资，未达到50%合并门槛。
model_changes.text_en: Sunway acquired a 33.43% stake in IJM Corporation Berhad via a conditional voluntary take-over offer, bringing IJM in as an associate/investment without crossing the 50% consolidation threshold.
